main_text.l: עטף Operuit; Obtectus; Obrutus fuit; Et cùm ad animum refertur, est Deficere, Deliquium pati: Partic. praeterit. plur. הָעֻטָּפִים Qui obruuntur, Thren.2.19. Et ex alia significatione, Serotina, Serotinæ pecudes, vel oves, sic dicta, quòd debiliores sint, & infirmitate quasi Obrutæ, ut Ab. Esra monet, Genes.30.42. Infinit. בַּעֲטֹף לִבִּי Quùm obruitur cor meum, Psalm.61.3. Futur. יַעְטֹף Obruetur, Jes.57.16. Item, Operiet, Job.23. v.9. יַעְטְפוּ בָר Obteguntur frumento, Psalm.65.14. Niph. Infinit. בְּעֻטַּף Cùm obrueretur, pro בְּהֵעָטֵף, Thren.2.11. quædam exemplaria habent Segol sub Beth, cui simile vide in הָרַג. Hiph. Infin. וּבְהַעְטִיף Et in ferotinando, id est, Quùm serò coirent, tempore scilicet secunda admissura, Genes.30.42. Hithp. Infinit. בְּהִתְעַטֵּף עָלַי Quùm obrueretur in me, Jon.2.8. בְּהִתְעַטְּפָם Quùm obruuntur, Deficiunt ipsi, Thren.2.12. Futur. תִּתְעַטָּף Obruitur, Deficit, Psalm.107. v.5.
מַעֲטֹפוֹת f.p. Amicula, quasi Operimenta dicta, Jesa.3. v.22. Targum שׁוּשִׁפְיָא [?] Palliola muliebria, Pallia: R.Sal. Tapeta.

עטר Circumcinxit, Circumclusit, Circumtexit: Particip. עֹטְרִים אֶל־דָּוִד Circumcludentes Davidem, 1.Sam.23.26. Futur. תַּעַטְרֵנוּ Circumtegu eum, Psal.5.13. vel, Facis ut circumtegat eum, quasi pro הַעֲטִירֵנוּ ex Hiphil, ut Kimchi vult. Pih. Praeteritum, עִטְּרַת שָׁנָה Coronas annum bonitatis tuæ, Psalm.65.12. significatione ex Nomine, quod Coronam significat, deductâ: שֶׁעִטְּרָה־לּוֹ [?] Quâ coronavit eum, Cantic.3. v.11. Particip. הַמְעַטְּרֵכִי Qui coronat vel circumtegit te, Psal.103.4. Fut. תְּעַטְּרֵהוּ Coronasti eum, Psalm.8. v.6. Hiph. Particip. הַמַּעֲטִירָה Coronans vel Coronaria, Jesa.23.8.
עֲטָרָה f. Corona, Ezech.21.26. Construct. עַטֶּרֶת־מַלְכָּם

page.notes: Hebrew lemmas and forms are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; vowel points and some letters are uncertain and marked [?] where doubtful, especially in the Pih., Hiph. and Hithp. forms and the Targum word. The Latin "f" in "Jef", "Genef" and "Jesa" is read as long s (Jes., Genes.). The lemma of the first entry and the other entry lemmas are printed in large type and are kept as the start of their paragraphs. The catchword "Coro-" is printed at the lower right.
